starting_digimon.selection: Uniform random candidate; fallback id 32 if the pool is empty.

digidigit_code_entry.lookup: First database entry whose code exactly equals the uppercased 5-character input.
digidigit_code_entry.ordinary_digimon_effect: If still locked, unlock it and place it in the first empty dock; Ancient type is unlocked but not docked.
digidigit_code_entry.spirit_effect: Set both spirits_unlocked[slot] and spirits_obtained[slot] true.

post_battle_capture.lost_spirit_precedence: An unlocked-but-not-obtained Spirit is recovered before a normal capture can be offered.
post_battle_capture.boss_victory: Unlock the canonical boss id. If its mapped Spirit is still locked, recover that Spirit; otherwise run the boss-catch flow.

final_area_rewards.normal_game_second_boss: Unlock Koichi in party and grant Spirit slots 10 and 11.
final_area_rewards.new_game: Uses ids 128/129 then 130 and does not grant the normal-game Koichi block.
